title: Missing API authentication specification
description: The API reference document describes request/response structures but does not document authentication requirements or token format. Consumers cannot implement the API correctly without this information.
suggested_resolution: Add a new section describing: (1) supported auth schemes (Bearer, API key, OAuth2), (2) token format and validity period, (3) example Authorization header, (4) error responses for missing or invalid credentials.
deferred_questions: Do we support multiple auth schemes or only Bearer tokens?
